title: Khaak urhaawo
body:
Khaak urhaawo
(Haae Zainab) x3 Haae Madina
<<MINI>>
(Are logo, ab khaak urhaao) x3
<<DIVIDER>>
Pardes se lut kar aaya, shabbir ka kunbaa saara
<<MINI>>
(Are logo, ab khaak urhaao) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Jo mera Hussein tha logo, jo yasrab ka tha ujala, pardes bulaa kar
usko, (aada ne maar hi daala) x2 khaime se mei chillayi, pyaasa hai mera
bhai
<<MINI>>
(Are logo, ab khaak urhaao) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Aabaad kabhi hota tha, ab hai wiraan madina, naa mei asghar ko laai, (na aayi saath sakina) x2 ik dashte bala ko dhaaya, ek ne hai shaam
basaaya
<<MINI>>
(Are logo, ab khaak urhaao) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Lo akber ki bhi sunlo, usne taqdeer rulaadi, shabbir ke haath pe
usne (karli hai mout se shaadi) x2 uski baatein howengi, sabki behne
rowengi
<<MINI>>
(Are logo, ab khaak urhaao) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Us waqt ghazab mei aayi, kehte hai aap karimi, jab khaak par khun
mei tarpi, (qaasim ki paak yatimi) x2 kuch shah khaimon mei laaye, kuch
ab tak dund na paae
<<MINI>>
(Are logo, ab khaak urhaao) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Us dasht mei kufi shaami, kehte the koun mohammed, shabbir pe sadqa
karke, (bheje hai aun mohammed) x2 na mei ab tak soyi hun, na bachon ko
royi hun
<<MINI>>
(Are logo, ab khaak urhaao) x2
<<DIVIDER>>
Shoukat farhaan bataado, sab gham ke baab sunaado, zainab chillayi
mujhko, (bas maa ki qabr dikhaado) x2 kab shehr mei reh paaungi, mei
shaam chali jaaungi
<<MINI>>
(Are logo, ab khaak urhaao) x2
